title: Croatian Pudding with Nutty Crunch
description: A traditional Croatian dessert with a crunchy nutty topping, perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the flour, sugar, and salt. Gradually add in the milk, whisking until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and stir in the butter until melted.
Pour the pudding mixture into individual serving cups.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pudding is set.
While the pudding is baking, mix together the chopped almonds and brown sugar in a small bowl.
Once the pudding is done, sprinkle the nutty topping over the top of each serving.
Serve warm, topped with additional nutty topping if desired.
